description: CREATE / SHOW / DESCRIBE / ALTER / DROP CORTEX SEARCH SERVICE: full definition storage, Snowflake's 20-column SHOW shape, defaulted and named EMBEDDING_MODEL, required WAREHOUSE/TARGET_LAG options, projection checks for search/attribute columns, OR REPLACE vs IF NOT EXISTS, comment set/unset, LIKE and scope filters, and the keywords staying usable as identifiers. Cell-level SHOW asserts read back via SELECT ... FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())). Converted 1:1 from CortexSearchServiceTest (now retired). Warehouses are account-level, so tests create them IF NOT EXISTS and drop them at the end.
